content:
Internal equality is implemented and merged, ready for the intrepid metaprogrammer to port irewrite!

To note: one challenging thing with this is that you can only write under nonexpansive functions. However, even in the port of Internal Eq itself, I encountered functions that were nonexpansive but were not safe to add as a typeclass instance (see: the new theorems in OFE.lean). I have no idea how hard it is to infer these, but it feels like it must be about as hard as implementing generalized rewriting. At the moment, you can still use the internal eq rewrite and rewrite' as theorems, passing in the instance you need by hand.
